contextWindow.description: The effective window used for inference, compaction and display.

compactionThreshold.description: Auto-compaction threshold resolved against this window.

requestedTier.description:
The requested context tier (`"default"`/`"long_context"`); absent when
unset. Older engines never send it.

effectiveTier.description: The tier the effective window belongs to, when known.

tierNote.description:
Why the requested tier is not in effect (`single_window`,
`tier_unavailable`, `capability_unknown`).

description:
`event/contextWindow` payload: the effective context window for the
session's model. Content-free.
title: ContextWindowEvent
